sn35.63:1.4: “One who lives alone” (_ekavihārī_) is also mentioned at [sn21.10:1.5]() and [thag10.2]().
sn35.63:2.8: MS omits _mano_ here in error. It is included in the following round in this Sutta, and in both rounds of the next Sutta. _Mano_ is found in the PTS and BJT editions, which I follow here.
